_comment: The first-run wizard's curated chat models (adr/0013), read by LLMTrayCore.ModelRecommendations. The ladder: a model is offered on every Mac with at least minMemoryGB whose GPU limit and memory it fits, so a bigger Mac sees the smaller ones too; recommendedFor: the memory tiers (GB of RAM: 8, 16, 24, 32 = 32 and up) it's the recommended model of, marked and listed first (one per tier); the others are labelled lighter or bigger than it, and those with the code capability as made for programming. approxBytes: the repo's current files (HF API, ?blobs=true), used until the Hub's live size is read. All our own quantizations. Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, 12B and 31B are Google's QAT on its exact q4_0 grid (quant-ternary gemma4-quant FINDINGS: as faithful as mlx-community's qat builds or better, and smaller); the E2B Phone build trades a little quality for ~1 GB; 12B and 31B are dense, slower than the 26B-A4B mixture of experts. The 12B's images and audio need the runtime pin from 17ab9af (ipsupport-llc/mlx-lm#22). Every repo here was checked to exist, be ungated and load with the pinned mlx-lm's model code (2026-10-02).

models.title: Gemma 4 26B-A4B (GPTQ)
models.summary: Google's mixture-of-experts Gemma 4 with 4B active parameters, quantized with GPTQ by LLMTray's authors; reads images and calls tools.

models.title: Gemma 4 12B (QAT)
models.summary: A dense Gemma 4 on Google's QAT grid, quantized by LLMTray's authors: better answers than E4B, but slower than 26B-A4B, which runs only 4B of its parameters per token; reads images, hears audio and calls tools.

models.title: Gemma 4 E4B (QAT)
models.summary: A small Gemma 4 on Google's QAT grid, quantized by LLMTray's authors, that leaves room for other apps on a 16 GB Mac; reads images, hears audio and calls tools.

models.title: Gemma 4 E2B (QAT)
models.summary: The small Gemma 4 on Google's QAT grid, quantized by LLMTray's authors, for an 8 GB Mac; reads images, hears audio and calls tools.

models.title: Gemma 4 E2B Phone (QAT)
models.summary: The smallest build here, almost a gigabyte under Gemma 4 E2B, for a Mac short on memory: quick, reads images and hears audio, but its answers are the simplest of the list.

models.title: Nemotron 3 Nano 4B, coding agent
models.summary: NVIDIA's small Nemotron, fine-tuned by LLMTray's authors for tool calling in a terminal coding agent; text only.

models.title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B, coding agent
models.summary: NVIDIA's mixture-of-experts Nemotron, fine-tuned by LLMTray's authors for tool calling in a terminal coding agent; text only.

models.title: Gemma 4 31B (QAT)
models.summary: The largest Gemma 4 on Google's QAT grid, quantized by LLMTray's authors: a dense model, the slowest here and the strongest on hard questions; reads images and calls tools.
